name: makermill/hydratype
description: Performance-first compiled object hydration and extraction for PHP.

scripts.watch: find src -name *.php | entr phpstan analyse -c phpstan.neon
scripts.phpstan:docker: docker run --rm --env XDEBUG_MODE=off --volume "${PWD}:/app" --workdir /app php82-cli:latest vendor/bin/phpstan analyse -c phpstan.neon --no-progress --memory-limit=1G
scripts.phpcs:docker: docker run --rm --env XDEBUG_MODE=off --volume "${PWD}:/app" --workdir /app php82-cli:latest vendor/bin/phpcs --standard=modified_psr12_ruleset.xml src
scripts.benchmark:assertions:docker: docker run --rm --env XDEBUG_MODE=off --volume "${PWD}:/app" --workdir /app php82-cli:latest php benchmarks/AssertionBenchmark.php
scripts.benchmark:cache-modes:docker: docker run --rm --env XDEBUG_MODE=off --volume "${PWD}:/app" --workdir /app php82-cli:latest php benchmarks/CacheModeBenchmark.php
scripts.benchmark:cold-compilation:docker: docker run --rm --env XDEBUG_MODE=off --volume "${PWD}:/app" --workdir /app php82-cli:latest php benchmarks/ColdCompilationBenchmark.php
scripts.benchmark:hydrator-strategy:docker: docker run --rm --env XDEBUG_MODE=off --volume "${PWD}:/app" --workdir /app php82-cli:latest php benchmarks/HydratorStrategyBenchmark.php
scripts.benchmark:object-creation:docker: docker run --rm --env XDEBUG_MODE=off --volume "${PWD}:/app" --workdir /app php82-cli:latest php benchmarks/ObjectCreationBenchmark.php
scripts.benchmark:writer-factory:docker: docker run --rm --env XDEBUG_MODE=off --volume "${PWD}:/app" --workdir /app php82-cli:latest php benchmarks/WriterFactoryBenchmark.php
scripts.benchmark:lazy-writers:docker: docker run --rm --env XDEBUG_MODE=off --volume "${PWD}:/app" --workdir /app php82-cli:latest php benchmarks/LazyWriterBenchmark.php
scripts.benchmark:map-value:docker: docker run --rm --env XDEBUG_MODE=off --volume "${PWD}:/app" --workdir /app php82-cli:latest php benchmarks/MapValueLookupBenchmark.php
scripts.benchmark:nested:docker: docker run --rm --env XDEBUG_MODE=off --volume "${PWD}:/app" --workdir /app php82-cli:latest php benchmarks/NestedHydrationBenchmark.php
